name: Protection Relay Operating Time
description: Operating time of an overcurrent relay. Checks whether fault clearance is fast enough to maintain transient stability.

elements.name: Relay Trip Time
elements.description: Time from fault inception to relay contact opening. Uncertain due to current transformer accuracy and relay ageing.

uncertainty.source: Protection study with CT accuracy class variation

elements.name: Critical Fault Clearance Time
elements.description: Critical clearance time from transient stability simulation

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(t_relay) = t_relay if t_relay <= t_cct, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The critical clearance time guards the relay operating time uncertainty set; trips slower than 80 ms allow generator pole-slip.
